    """Draw marker-colored line segments between aligned marker cells, greedily pairing the most distant aligned markers first."""
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(rows) for c in range(cols) if grid[r][c] == marker]
    pairs = []
    for a in range(len(pts)):

            if r1 == r2 or c1 == c2:
                pairs.append((abs(r1 - r2) + abs(c1 - c2), a, b))
    pairs.sort(reverse=True)
    used, lines = set(), []
    for d, a, b in pairs:
        if a not in used and b not in used:
